Testcase Name: Check System requirements
Test Steps:
Reference: docs/user-guide/get-started/system-requirements.md
Operating Systems
- Ubuntu 24.04 LTS or later
Hardware Platforms (on-device: integrated GPU shares system RAM; no discrete accelerator or remote inference cluster required)
- Intel® Core™ Ultra processor with integrated GPU (validated on Panther Lake, PTL 358H)
- At least 64 GB RAM (default target for Qwen3.5-35B-A3B FP8, 60k context)
- At least 32 GB swap (so the weight load and KV cache can spill under peak memory pressure)
- At least 128 GB disk space (model weights + Hugging Face cache)
Software
- Docker 24.0
- Python 3.10
Expected Result: Meet system requirements

Testcase Name: Register a custom task from anchor content
Test Steps: 1. Use the example anchor content shipped with the tests as-is: tests/resources/task_playground_safety.txt (GLOBAL_PROMPT / MACRO_CHUNK_PROMPT / LOCAL_PROMPT / T_MINUS_1_PROMPT).
Expected Result: Registration returns 201 with the task detail; the task appears as source=dynamic in GET /v1/tasks and is persisted under VIDEO_SUMMARY_CACHE. GET /v1/tasks/{name} round-trips the content.

Test Steps:
2. Register the task:
jq -Rs '{task_name: "playground_safety", mode: "full", content: {text: .}}' \
  tests/resources/task_playground_safety.txt \
| curl http://localhost:8192/v1/tasks -H "Content-Type: application/json" --data-binary @-

3. Send GET request to confirm round-trip:
curl -X GET "http://localhost:8192/v1/tasks/playground_safety"

Testcase Name: Auto-fill / literal-brace fallbacks reduce avoidable errors
Test Steps:
1. Register with only the two REQUIRED anchors (GLOBAL_PROMPT + LOCAL_PROMPT); MACRO/T_MINUS_1 and missing time placeholders are auto-filled:
jq -Rs '{task_name: "minimal_report", mode: "full", content: {text: .}}' \
  tests/resources/task_minimal_report.txt \
| curl http://localhost:8192/v1/tasks -H "Content-Type: application/json" --data-binary @-
Expected Result: Avoidable errors are auto-fixed: MACRO/T_MINUS_1 are auto-filled from generic defaults and missing time/context placeholders are scaffolded (201). Non-placeholder braces (example JSON/code) are treated as literal text. {chunk_subtitle} is accepted as optional. A genuinely missing required anchor returns 422 missing_anchors with a hint that only GLOBAL_PROMPT and LOCAL_PROMPT are required.

Test Steps:
2. Prompt embedding literal example JSON (unrecognized braces rendered verbatim) still registers (expect 201):
jq -Rs '{task_name: "literal_json_task", mode: "full", content: {text: .}}' \
  tests/resources/task_forgiving_literal_json.txt \
| curl http://localhost:8192/v1/tasks -H "Content-Type: application/json" --data-binary @-

3. Prompt referencing the optional {chunk_subtitle} placeholder in LOCAL_PROMPT registers (expect 201):
jq -Rs '{task_name: "subtitle_ref_task", mode: "full", content: {text: .}}' \
  tests/resources/task_forgiving_subtitle.txt \
| curl http://localhost:8192/v1/tasks -H "Content-Type: application/json" --data-binary @-

4. Omitting the required GLOBAL_PROMPT is rejected (expect 422, error=missing_anchors, with hint):
jq -Rs '{task_name: "missing_global_task", mode: "full", content: {text: .}}' \
  tests/resources/task_forgiving_missing_global.txt \
| curl -sw "\nHTTP %{http_code}\n" http://localhost:8192/v1/tasks -H "Content-Type: application/json" --data-binary @-

5. Clean up the tasks registered in steps 1-3:
for t in minimal_report literal_json_task subtitle_ref_task; do curl -X DELETE "http://localhost:8192/v1/tasks/$t"; done
